# Bookmarks in temporary inline controls

Original OPC/XML source generated by tools/temporary_control_bookmarks_fixture.py.
Nine cases cover interior, boundary, point and hyperlink bookmarks; an endpoint
outside the wrapper; and whole, interior and overlapping placeholder bookmarks.
Arial is referenced, not distributed. No corpus document is modified.

tools/record_temporary_control_bookmarks.ps1 opens an independent read-only source
for each native scenario, then saves a separate reference-application result. The reference application
accepts all nine sources. Formatting visible characters and deleting a bookmark
retain the temporary control. Inserting text removes the wrapper. Placeholder
replacement removes bookmarks wholly contained in the prompt. An overlapping
bookmark retains its outside text and excludes the inserted placeholder value.

native-results.json records all 36 native cases. The four native DOCX outputs retain
the actual resulting XML; native.pdf records the unchanged one-page print view.
manifest.json binds their exact bytes. The reference application character offsets include hyperlink
field instructions, so the capture locates the visible hyperlink result before
editing it. Native partial replacement of placeholder text was rejected as a
protected selection; the capture instead replaces that whole placeholder range.

The initial browser preview of the control page was inspected against the reference application. The
source, native exports and corpus/browser regression exports pass schema checks.
The overlapping-placeholder case requires the surviving end marker to stay before
the replacement value. The editor regression compares those native endpoints as
well as wrapper ownership, visible text, export/reopen and exact undo.

Additional UI capture: `placeholder-format-native.docx` was saved from a copy of
`control.docx` in the reference application. Click each of the four placeholder prompts and
click Home > Bold, then save. The reference application selects all of `Alpha beta` on a click; from
the prompt's end, Shift+Left also selects the whole prompt. All four prompts
become bold, retain their wrappers and retain bookmark scope. The other five
controls are unchanged. The manifest binds this separately captured file.

The COM `format-native.docx` reference deliberately retains the earlier partial
Range.Font.Bold action. For the four placeholders this is a silent no-op, unlike
the UI's whole-prompt selection. Tests compare ordinary partial formatting with
that COM reference and selected-placeholder formatting with the UI reference;
they check every resulting character's bold state, not only wrapper retention.
The editor expands a nonempty selection touching an inline placeholder for text
formatting. A caret continues to set pending input formatting independently of
the cached prompt's appearance.
